_about: Real recordings, kept OUT of git. Put the files in a folder and run: BANDKITCHEN_MEDIA_DIR=/path/to/folder pytest -m local_media. File names are glob patterns relative to that folder. expected_offset_s is the hand-sync measured to the sample from the iMovie export.

cases.name: The Man (The Killers), drums
cases._tolerance_note: Auto-sync lands ~+13 ms from the hand-sync; kick vs snare timing alone differs by 10-20 ms on this take. Tighten once we decide how to reconcile with by-ear alignment.
